stories.intent: Typing under poor Wi-Fi: keystroke echo p95 within 2xRTT+250 ms (0.550 s), at most one patch gap per 10 s, no pending-reason anchor plan, converged within 2 s of the last keystroke.
One 900x620 wheel scroll under long-haul conditions: first visual change within 1 s, pending_cells monotone to 0 within 8 s, at most one anchor plan, no stuck repair, 2-5 fps.

A 10 s black-hole with a keystroke during it: the session parks and resumes, no rejected resume, recovery p95 within 2xRTT+2 s, one accepted resume per receiver, input applied after restore or expired within its deadline and never applied late.

Five cycles of 10 s down / 10 s up: the session survives every cycle with one resumed media session per receiver per cycle and no new handshake, no TTL park eviction, no duplicate input injection, and a bounded reconnect ladder.

A full-screen change under long-haul conditions is delivered as a progressive anchor plan: no reset update, every plan update atomic and within budget, pending_cells monotone between input events, completion within 8 s.

Typing during a converging full-screen change at T3: keystroke echo stays within the tier bound, input is never queued behind media (queue depth and relay-send latency bounded), and the media rate cap holds.

Continuous motion at T3 and, with an anchor plan, at T4: every hop's queue stays within its configured cap, one pending update per receiver, cell state bounded, no monotone growth. The live ten-minute run is the netem harness's; this scenario is the deterministic invariant harness for INV-5.

A degrade/recover cycle at T3 where every recovery step is attributed to exactly one hop: the sum of hop reports plus link loss equals receiver-reported loss within one object, and every session-state transition has a series.

A media-lane-only loss then a full loss on a fast link: the session resumes with no reset update, the first update after resume chains onto the receiver's held update (patch_gaps 0), one accepted resume per loss, and the control lane stays intact throughout the media-lane-only phase.

Ctrl+Alt+Shift held across a 20 s black-hole: the park grace releases every key, after restore only the keys still physically held are re-established, and no key remains down at session end. INV-4 holds in every profile.

Text-first mode at the middle of the T4 band: applied fps at or above 1 over any 5 s window, at least 90 percent of keystrokes echoed within 2xRTT+250 ms, at most one expired input object, audio off by default, and the UI states the degraded mode.

Datagram carrier selection at T4 (S2): promotion only when the datagram carrier's goodput beats the WebSocket path with hysteresis, demotion on degradation or channel close, no switch during a plan or pulse, update identity continuous across a switch.

The media WebSocket cannot be opened, so the session runs lane_mode=single on poor Wi-Fi: the session is live, input keeps its priority bound, media is still paced, and the receiver shows the benign single-connection note.
LAN regression guard: no netem at all, a full-screen change and pointer motion with zero patch gaps, zero dropped updates, no anchor plan, and pacing that never delays an update beyond 1 ms.

Rollout safety: a receiver against a sender whose media lane is unsupported. The session connects and stays usable, the media lane is refused with a typed reason, input and terminal still work, and the score is reported as 0 with the reason rather than missing. No network degradation is involved.
